name: Mirrorface
description: Inhabits facial recognition augments and occasionally swaps faces — you see your own face on a stranger, or a stranger's face on someone you know. Lasts 1-3 seconds.
observed_behavior: Overlays stored facial recognition data onto live visual feed. The substitutions are brief, vivid, and deeply unsettling.
story_hooks: A freelancer sees a dead friend's face on a stranger in a crowd and follows them — into a trap or a revelation
